items.text: An old friend of Moash's from before the Shattered Plains, Guff met him again in Revolar after the singers took the city. Guff was a guard for the local brightlord, Paladar, and was surprised to see Moash alive, having thought him dead.
Learning Moash had been a soldier, Guff took him to Paladar, but Moash's silence under questioning got Guff beaten and replaced.

appearance.text: An older man about half a reed tall, with an injury that affects how he walks.
